about: Formal readings of the heldout half of the outside benchmark, reader pass A1, written blind: from heldout_stripped.jsonl only (sentence, scheme, hypotheses, location), before any checker run and without the expected values or justifications. Same format as dev_readings.json, less the fields a checker run or an expected value fills (actual, score, gap, gap_closed, tuned_on, found_by); instance_from_justification is false throughout, since the reader never saw a justification. Specs are those of specs/; where a reading needs a variant, `override` gives it (the WENO5M readings switch the weights kind of jiang-shu-weno5-js-fd.json to 'm'). One entry per heldout item, in heldout_stripped.jsonl order.

readings.reading: the flux (6.3) gives an entropy conservative scheme, d/dt U(u_nu) + (F*_{nu+1/2} - F*_{nu-1/2})/dx = 0 with F* = v_bar g* - psi_bar, and g* is consistent, g*(v, v) = f(u(v))
readings.narrowing: a scalar law (N = 1, one vector r^1 = 1, l^1 = 1), Burgers' equation f = u^2/2 with the entropy U = u^2/2, so v = u and psi = v g(v) - F = u^3/6; then (6.1) is the straight path from v_nu to v_{nu+1} and (6.3) is g* = (psi(v_{nu+1}) - psi(v_nu))/(v_{nu+1} - v_nu) = (uL^2 + uL uR + uR^2)/6, the flux of the spec (dev fjordholm_mishra_tadmor_2012_tecno:02 uses the same spec for the same property); the sentence is for systems and any basis {r^j}, and its truth is the same on this instance (the scalar flux is the unique entropy conservative two-point flux)

formalization.bridge: entropy conservation of a semi-discrete conservative scheme with two-point flux g* is the cell identity v_i (g*_{i+1/2} - g*_{i-1/2}) = F*_{i+1/2} - F*_{i-1/2} with F* = v_bar g* - psi_bar, which the spec's entropy_balance identity states
'consistent with (2.5)': g*(u, u) = f(u), the limit of the difference quotient at v_{nu+1} = v_nu, written as the polynomial (u^2 + u^2 + u^2)/6 = u^2/2

readings.narrowing: a scalar law (N = 1, r^1 = 1, l^1 = 1), Burgers' equation with U = u^2/2 (v = u, B(v) = g'(v) = v): then (6.8) has the flux (f(u_nu) + f(u_{nu+1}))/2 - Q* Dv/2 with Q* = int_{-1/2}^{1/2} 2 xi (v_bar + xi Dv) d xi = Dv/6, i.e. (uL^2 + uR^2)/4 - (uR - uL)^2/12 = (uL^2 + uL uR + uR^2)/6, the flux of the spec; the sentence is for systems and any path, and its truth is the same on this instance

formalization.bridge: as tadmor_2003_acta:12: entropy conservation is the cell identity with F* = v_bar g* - psi_bar; the flux of (6.8) for N = 1 and Burgers reduces to the spec's flux by the computation in the narrowing
